Studio Type B and 2 BR Type C also have differing internal figures across the two sources. review.gallery: Two verified August 2026 Ellington construction archive photographs and seven native renders from the original Belmont brochure. The photograph with the signed corner frontage is the gallery lead and listing card. Photos and renders have distinct captions.
review.location: Developer District 4 site map agrees with the same project coordinates from JRE, Dubainary and House Finder. Fourteen brochure estimates transcribed visually. Al Khail Avenue’s operating status was not established, so the brochure time to that mall is omitted.
review.floorPlans: Nineteen intact source leaves: twelve residential layouts, four amenity/typical plans, and three separately labelled source variants. Studio B internal 614.40 (brochure) versus 612.40 (floor plans); 2 BR C 1171.87 versus 1171.84. For the 805.89 plan, the room drawing and brochure title agree on one bedroom but the standalone plan title says two. The 768.87 terrace total differs from the printed component sum by 0.11. Both PDFs and original physical page links retained.

unavailable: Verified unit-specific contract drawings and direct visitor entrance coordinates. The exterior photographs do not establish individual handover or access.
